title: Finding quality: add CVSS score, OWASP mapping, business impact, step-by-step remediation, and proof-of-concept reference to every finding
goal: Enterprise pentest reports require structured finding data that AegisPT currently partially provides. Enhance finding quality: (1) CVSS Score — add CVSS 3.1 base score calculation or lookup. When a CVE is matched, pull CVSS from NVD. When no CVE, calculate from severity/impact/exploitability fields that the runner already provides. Show CVSS gauge in Finding drawer. (2) OWASP mapping — map each finding to the relevant OWASP category: OWASP Top 10 (for web), OWASP API Security Top 10 (for API), OWASP Mobile Top 10 (for mobile). This mapping is deterministic by finding type — do it in the finding creation layer. (3) Business Impact — AI enrichment (via ChatGPT OAuth) fills a short business impact statement: 'An attacker exploiting this could gain access to customer payment data.' Stored as ai_business_impact field. (4) Step-by-step remediation — AI fills concrete remediation steps per technology stack. Not generic advice — stack-aware: 'On Apache 2.4.49, apply patch CVE-2021-41773 via apt upgrade apache2 or rebuild the container with base image apache:2.4.54+.' (5) Proof of concept reference — when a runner captures proof (HTTP request/response, nmap output, hash), link it explicitly from the finding with a 'Reproduce' button that shows the exact evidence with timestamps.
scope: Competitive analysis: Burp Suite findings include request/response proof. Nessus findings include CVSS scores and detailed remediation. Commercial pentest reports include OWASP mapping, business impact, and step-by-step remediation. AegisPT findings have severity, title, and description but lack structured CVSS, OWASP mapping, and AI-enriched business context.
generation_reason: Gap vs Burp/Nessus: findings lack CVSS scores, OWASP mapping, AI business impact, and stack-aware remediation — required for enterprise-grade pentest reports.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add fields and enrichment to existing finding model. Do not restructure finding storage or change report generation in this task.

success_criteria: Every finding has a CVSS score (NVD-sourced for CVE findings, calculated for others).
Every finding has an OWASP category mapping.
AI enrichment fills business_impact and remediation_steps fields (when ChatGPT connected).
Finding drawer shows CVSS gauge, OWASP badge, business impact, and 'Reproduce' button.
No regression in findings E2E tests.

acceptance_criteria: AI business impact and remediation available when ChatGPT connected.
